findings.title: Sync wrapper hides that the view is async, so async views break
findings.explanation:
The `@wraps(view)` decorator copies `__name__`, `__doc__`, `__dict__` and similar attributes. It does not copy the CO_COROUTINE flag, which lives on the code object of an `async def`. As a result, `inspect.iscoroutinefunction(wrapper)` / `asgiref.iscoroutinefunction(wrapper)` returns False for an async function view decorated with `@non_atomic_requests`.

On the sync path, `BaseHandler._get_response` calls the wrapper and gets back a coroutine object. On the async path, `_get_response_async` wraps the view in `sync_to_async` because it looks sync, and that call also returns a coroutine. Either way, `check_response` then raises `ValueError("... returned an unawaited coroutine instead")`.

Before this change the original function was returned unchanged, so async views worked. Class-based views from `as_view()` still work, because their marker set by `markcoroutinefunction` is stored in `__dict__` and gets copied. Plain `async def` views decorated with `@transaction.non_atomic_requests` now fail on every request.
findings.suggestion: Build the wrapper to match the view's mode. If `iscoroutinefunction(view)` is true, define `async def wrapper(*args, **kwargs): return await view(*args, **kwargs)`; otherwise use the sync wrapper. Then set `wrapper._non_atomic_requests = databases`. Add a test that runs an async view decorated with `non_atomic_requests`.

findings.title: Sync wrapper breaks async views decorated with non_atomic_requests
findings.explanation: The new wrapper is a plain sync function. For an async view, the wrapper is no longer a coroutine function, because functools.wraps does not preserve that. Django's handlers check iscoroutinefunction(view) to choose the sync or async path and to adapt views. An async view decorated with @non_atomic_requests will be treated as sync. Calling it returns an unawaited coroutine, which gives the 'returned an unawaited coroutine' error. It also fails to be recognised as async under ATOMIC_REQUESTS handling.
findings.suggestion: Create an async wrapper (async def, awaiting the view) when iscoroutinefunction(view) is true. Otherwise use the sync wrapper. Alternatively, copy the view with a mechanism that preserves its coroutine marker.
